description: Admin triage view for mcp_submissions table (portal already exists, admin view does not). Surfaces pending MCP submissions with columns: mcp_name (not mcp_identifier), requested_by (not requester_name), submitted_at, status. Uses write_service :8772. Authenticated via X-API-Key. All values parameterized to prevent SQL injection. Inserts audit_log row on any admin action (approve/reject/triage).
